text:
The pedestrian will not prevail. A misrepresentation claim requires justifiable reliance and damages caused by that reliance, and he rejected the $1,000 offer, hired counsel, and recovered a full $550,000 verdict, so the false statement caused him no loss. An adjuster’s assertion about legal entitlement during an adversarial claim negotiation is also not a factual representation on which reliance is justified.

CONFIDENCE: 88
